quotes.text: Also, did you use AI to write this?

AI is a tool that can empower our public servants, but it is not a substitute for passionate and committed federal workers. [...] As we discuss the use of artificial intelligence in government, we must have people at the center of the conversation, including the people we represent and the federal workers who serve our country.

Now, the Social Security Administration wants to cut an additional seven thousand employees and somehow use AI to handle calls from seniors. That does not work, because I know that when my constituents have a problem with their Social Security, they would rather talk to a person than a computer program.

As AI shrinks the number of available entry-level jobs, we cannot afford to leave an entire generation behind.
 
I introduced my bill to expand AmeriCorps by 500K positions to give young people a path to meaningful careers. https://t.co/FOdvu8qn46
